fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant reported that a yellow auto bearing registration number TN-38-YY-1073 was missing from the stand near Kalai Layout Parking Area in Tiruppur. The matter was brought to Tiruppur South PS on 2025-01-16, while the incident was placed on 2025-01-15 at approximately 21:50. Hemanth Murugan reported the matter orally at Tiruppur South PS; the contact number given was 9000000301. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Madhan Palanisamy, using the number 9000000295. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Auto reportedly taken from an unattended stand during the night.
fields.Keywords: auto theft, vehicle, night, CCTV, vehicle observation, parking area, mobile number, auto
